intro.title: What Is an AI Bikini Generator?

content.title: Preview swimwear ideas without changing the person
content.text: An AI bikini generator edits only the visible clothing area in an adult person photo. Toolaze uses a reference-guided flow: upload the original person as image 1, upload or choose a bikini reference as image 2, then generate a swimwear preview that keeps the original face, body shape, body proportions, pose, background, lighting, and camera angle stable.

content.title: Tasteful adult swimwear previews
content.text: Create beachwear concepts, vacation styling, creator thumbnails, resort moodboards, and outfit-planning visuals. Results are visual previews, not fit guarantees. Avoid requests that remove clothing, sexualize a person, edit minors, impersonate someone, or use images without permission.

howToUse.title: How to Generate a Bikini Preview with AI

steps.title: Upload the original person photo
steps.desc: Use a clear adult photo where the current outfit, torso, arms, and body outline are visible. Straightforward poses work better than heavy occlusion or motion blur.

steps.title: Add a bikini reference or choose Custom
steps.desc: Upload a swimwear reference as image 2 or choose one built-in reference. In Custom mode, upload one person photo and describe the bikini style, coverage, color, fabric, and straps.

steps.title: Generate and review the unchanged areas
steps.desc: Check that the face, body shape, pose, hands, background, lighting, and camera angle remain stable. Refine the prompt if the model changes anything beyond the swimwear.

photoTips.title: Photo Tips for Better Bikini Edits
photoTips.subtitle: The strongest results come from clear source photos and direct preservation instructions.

items.title: Use an adult photo with visible clothing
items.desc: Choose a photo you own or have permission to edit. The person must be an adult, and the outfit area should be easy to identify.

items.title: Keep the pose simple
items.desc: Standing, seated, or lightly angled poses usually preserve body shape better than crossed arms, mirrors, heavy shadows, or covered torsos.

items.title: Use a readable swimwear reference
items.desc: Full-body swimwear references help the model match straps, coverage, fabric, color, and silhouette without inventing extra details.

items.title: Tell the model what not to change
items.desc: Repeat preserve face, body shape, body proportions, pose, hands, background, lighting, and camera angle when exact identity and framing matter.

faq.q: Is Toolaze AI Bikini Generator free?
faq.a: Yes. New users receive 10 free credits after sign-up. Seedream 5.0 Lite starts at 10 credits for standard 1K generation, so those credits are enough for one eligible standard bikini preview. Higher resolution or continued use may require more credits.

faq.q: Which model does the AI Bikini Generator use?
faq.a: Toolaze uses Seedream 5.0 Lite for this swimwear preview workflow.

faq.q: Will the tool change my face or body shape?
faq.a: The default prompt tells the model to replace only the visible clothing and keep the face, identity, body shape, body proportions, pose, background, lighting, and camera angle unchanged. You should still review the output before using it.

faq.q: Can I upload my own bikini reference?
faq.a: Yes. In Bikini Reference mode, upload the person photo first and then upload a swimwear reference or choose one of the built-in references.

faq.q: Can I use it without a bikini reference image?
faq.a: Yes. Use Custom mode, upload one adult person photo, and describe the swimwear style, coverage, color, straps, fabric, and occasion.

faq.q: What safety rules should I follow?
faq.a: Use adult photos you own or have permission to edit. Avoid requests involving minors, explicit content, clothing removal, impersonation, or images used without consent.
